assumptions: 'customer emails' means the email and requester_email fields on customers, users, newsletter_subscribers, patients and support_tickets; users and patients were included because they use the same field name
record_audit_event is the audit function the customer means by 'who changed what', because it is the only writer of audit_log
when.fields matches statements that assign the named field (per the catalogue text 'assigned field names')
ai.agent.run and while/foreach are exact statement and block names (the parser did not reject them)
a while loop in a task is an acceptable proxy for an unbounded retry, with the owner exempting legitimate loops
why_confidence: The AI-in-loop rule directly targets the incident and is likely to flag nightly_ticket_summaries. The retry rule is a coarse while-loop proxy that flags every task while loop, not only unbounded retries. The audit rule checks that a call exists, not what it records, and skips writes inside functions and other field changes. The spend cap has no check at all.
